payload.core_mechanism_summary: Exhaustive enumeration over all 6^n vertex color assignments via base-6 mask, counting distinct domino types on edges.
payload.rationale: The code uses a loop over all mask values (0..6^n-1) to try every color assignment, making it a complete enumeration. This matches search_bitmask_enumeration as a generalized bitmask (base-6). No DFS/BFS or backtracking.
